Name: Resident Evil Milking the Evil Residents
Author: CelestialsRequiem
Description:
[size=4][b]Ever wanted to "milk" Resident Evil characters? No? Well I sure have![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Turn your barn into a specialized holding cell for your favorites! They can't escape you here![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Use your charm (and the hope of escaping your clutches) to build friendship with them (and make them fall madly in love until they no longer want to escape), they'll give you items in return (they're not bargaining for their release, don't listen to them).[/b][/size]

[b]Leon's Produce (2,4,9):[/b]
"Cream" (small and large), can be processed into Musk (small or large) in the press.
On rare ocassions, he'll drop his jacket for you!
(This applies to all 3 Leons, but each has his own unique jacket.)

[size=4][b]Kidna-I mean adopt your favorite Resident Evil character TODAY! [/b][/size]
[size=4][b](We've only caught RE2 Leon but the others are well on their way!)[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Tested with:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Basically any expansion mod. Shouldn't really conflict with anything but unique item IDs are in the works just in case.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Whole mod was made by me and someone dear and close to me, as a joke at first. We made all the sprites and code on our own! (Mostly him but I helped!)[/b][/size]

[i][b][u]Translations welcome if ya credit and link mod btw[/u][/b][/i]


[i][u]What's next:[/u][/i]
1.Re4 and Re9 Leon with their own unique sprites and jackets (produce stays the same otherwise.
2. Claire Redfield with her own unique "produce" and jacket.
3. Rebecca Chambers as well, she'll drop her medical bag instead of her jacket along with her "produce".
4. Grace Ashcroft, I'll probably add the jacket she loses at the hotel intro.
5. Wesker, he'll drop his glasses cause we all know there's just infinite glasses under his glasses anyways.
6. Twink Chris, don't really know what he'd drop other than "produce" yet.
7. Old, dilf Chris. Dunno what he'd drop either.

[b]YES THIS STARTED AS A JOKE BUT I'M KINDA HAVING FUN WITH IT.[/b]
